Divide between two plates and top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately while hot.

steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil over high heat.
Add 8 oz pasta and cook according to package directions until al dente, then drain.
While pasta cooks, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.

call.title: Set Up Your Home WiFi Router
call.summary: Get your WiFi router connected and broadcasting a secure wireless network in your home.
items: Device to configure router (laptop, phone, or tablet)
steps: Connect the power cable to your router and plug it into an outlet. Wait 30 seconds for it to start up.
Connect your modem to the router's WAN or internet port using an Ethernet cable. If your modem and router are combined, skip this step.
On your phone, tablet, or laptop, open WiFi settings and find your router's default network name (usually printed on a sticker on the device).
Select the network and enter the default password if required (also on the sticker).
Open a web browser and go to your router's admin page, typically 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1. Check the sticker for the exact address.
Log in using the default username and password (found on the device sticker).
Follow the setup wizard to create a new WiFi network name and a strong password of your choice.
Save your settings and wait for the router to restart.
Reconnect to your new network using your chosen password.
Test your connection by opening a website or running a speed test to confirm internet access.

steps: Unpack the router and locate the power cable, ethernet cable, and documentation.
Place the router in a central, elevated location away from walls and metal objects for optimal signal coverage.
Connect the modem to the router using an ethernet cable in the WAN or Internet port.
Plug the router into a power outlet and wait 2-3 minutes for it to fully boot up.
Open a web browser on a device and visit the router's setup page (usually printed on the router or manual).
Create a strong admin password to secure your router's settings.
Select your WiFi network name (SSID) and create a strong WiFi password using WPA3 or WPA2 encryption.
Save your settings and reconnect all devices to the new WiFi network using your new password.
Update the router firmware if a newer version is available through the admin panel.
Test your internet connection on multiple devices to confirm everything is working properly.

call.title: Change a Flat Tire
steps: Locate the flat tire and pull over to a safe, flat area away from traffic.
Turn on your hazard lights and engage the parking brake.
Remove the spare tire, jack, and lug wrench from your vehicle's trunk or storage area.
Loosen the lug nuts on the flat tire by a quarter turn before lifting the vehicle.
Position the jack under the vehicle's frame near the flat tire and raise the vehicle until the tire is about 6 inches off the ground.
Unscrew and remove all lug nuts completely, then carefully pull the flat tire straight toward you to remove it.
Mount the spare tire onto the lug bolts and push it in until the wheel hub is flush with the bolts.
Hand-tighten the lug nuts onto the bolts in a star pattern to ensure even pressure.
Lower the vehicle back to the ground by turning the jack handle counterclockwise.
Tighten the lug nuts firmly in a star pattern using the lug wrench.
Check the spare tire pressure as soon as possible and drive carefully to a repair shop.
